baseline.product_scope: source inventory only; no product code change

snapshot.authority: Existing registries, generated capability metadata, USE_CASES.md, CAPABILITIES.md, and TRACKER.md retain authority. This file reconciles them for the near-native application model; it is not a replacement registry.
snapshot.acceptance_note: A tracker Done state means merged implementation, not native-quality acceptance. A declared surface, source path, test path, or prior root run does not prove that the owner completed the job.

scope.question: What jobs and surfaces are currently declared when HoldSpeak is viewed as a near-native desktop application with windows and resource applications?
included: The current Desk application manifest, including active and parked rows.
Registered object pullout kinds, with specialized/redirect/fallback distinctions, and specialized window hosts.
Actual jobs represented by current use-case, capability, inventory, and betterment records.
The 117 tracker recipe slices, using cluster-qualified references where bare IDs collide.
Shared application behavior needed by the application model and explicit baseline gaps.
excluded: A claim that every runtime path was exercised.
A new explorer, OS file manager, native replacement toolkit, or application process model.
A claim that repository APIs provide general OS filesystem access.
Owner-state walks, network calls, fresh browser runs, performance benchmarks, or test execution in this audit.
Parked code and parked tests as proof of active behavior.
limits: Source anchors are baseline-specific and may drift after merges.
The filesystem explorer workload is proposed acceptance work; current RepoWindow behavior is partial.
Evidence labels separate inspected source, a test file existing, a root-executed bounded check recorded elsewhere, and unknown behavior.
Native presence is kept disabled after the documented broken-renderer incident; no repair is inferred.
The 47 families and 34 domain labels are audit groupings, not upstream catalogue counts; source coverage does not establish executed behavioral coverage.

evidence_legend.source_inspected: The named source or record was read during this audit; it proves a declaration or implementation seam only.
evidence_legend.tests_exist: A concrete test file exists in the source inventory; this audit does not claim it executed or proves the full job.
evidence_legend.root_executed: A bounded execution explicitly recorded by the repository authority; it is not an owner observation and is not inferred from a filename.
evidence_legend.owner_observed: An owner desk walk or owner acceptance record. None is asserted by this snapshot unless named.
evidence_legend.unknown: The record does not establish the behavior, or the audit did not run it. Unknown is not failure and not acceptance.

use_case_families.basis: Audit groupings, not an upstream declared-family count.

shared_behavior_codes.APP_ID: Stable logical application, window instance and resource identity.
shared_behavior_codes.WIN_LIFE: Open, restore, raise, minimize, close and reopen without stealing focus.
shared_behavior_codes.FOCUS: Separate front-window authority, focused control and selected object/resource.
shared_behavior_codes.NAV_HISTORY: Per-window location, breadcrumb, Back/Forward history and restoration.
shared_behavior_codes.SELECTION: Per-view focused item, selected set, anchor, range and modifier semantics.
shared_behavior_codes.COMMANDS: One target-aware command/verb context for menus, keys, context actions and voice.
shared_behavior_codes.VIEW_MODES: One collection model across list, icon, tree or treegrid views.
shared_behavior_codes.RESOURCE_ADAPTER: Typed children, metadata, content and supported operations with domain identity.
shared_behavior_codes.PERSISTENCE: Workspace/view restoration with identity and stale-location validation.
shared_behavior_codes.EDIT_IME: Native editing, caret/selection, composition, voice insertion, undo and recovery.
shared_behavior_codes.TRANSFER: Explicit internal reference, browser file drop and OS transfer semantics.
shared_behavior_codes.OP_OUTCOME: Visible pending, success, refusal, partial, conflict, interruption and indeterminate outcomes.
shared_behavior_codes.ASYNC_STALE: Loading versus empty, stale response rejection and retained drafts/work.
shared_behavior_codes.SOURCE: Source identity, citation/context selection and provenance retention.
shared_behavior_codes.EGRESS: Named destination/host and clear boundary when information leaves the desk.
shared_behavior_codes.FEEDBACK: An immediate, truthful receipt or error at the operation location.
shared_behavior_codes.SURFACE: Shared component/surface species and explicit ownership of layout/material.
shared_behavior_codes.NATIVE_BOUNDARY: Browser/native adapter boundary for host, OS and device capabilities.
shared_behavior_codes.SCROLL: Bounded scroll ownership, follow/pause and preserved position.
shared_behavior_codes.COVERAGE: Evidence status is explicit; implementation state is not acceptance.

specialized_window_families.gap: Application identity, navigation, selection and operation outcomes are not one complete explorer contract.
Retired Brief and week ids are migration history; Chair is not the whole application framework.
Conversation state and request recovery need shared application/view ownership.
Terminal input, bounded scrollback, stop and recovery need one run-monitor contract.
Current tree/status/path navigation has no Back/Forward stack or document-opening view.
A workbench job/run outcome must remain visible and truthful across delayed and failed work.
Forms are useful consumers but do not by themselves prove application-model behavior.
Collection selection and cross-window identity are still not shared with Explorer semantics.
Renderer root cause and owner-quality close/focus proof are unknown; do not re-enable from this inventory.

public_use_case_reconciliation.source_row: Run a model on another machine

capability_reconciliation.authority: Generated capability authority: docs/generated/capabilities.yaml. Each ID is mapped below to a job family or an explicit non-UI/backend bucket; this does not claim a matching window exists.
capability_reconciliation.mapping_granularity: Group-level audit associations, not per-command bindings or proof of behavior. Empty lists are explicit backend-only or external-client buckets. External clients can have their own UI; not_ui means no React Desk entry is established here.

use_case_families.job: Get a thought down now and keep the saved note

unknown: Cold owner capture-to-saved-note timing and physical audio quality

use_case_families.current_behavior: New Note and Capture are declared paths; NotePullout and its editor preserve the note record seam.
gaps: Capture, note, and speech insertion do not yet share one complete application task contract.

use_case_families.job: Speak and see text land in the focused application

unknown: Hardware microphone walk, complete delivery in a real focused app, and end-to-end transcript quality

use_case_families.current_behavior: Voice capture, transcription, pipeline and delivery are separate generated capabilities with one mic session seam.
gaps: Generic dictation appends in NoteEditor instead of a shared selection/caret insertion contract; late-result and target semantics need one adapter.

use_case_families.job: Correct a phrase and replay or learn it later

unknown: A complete owner correction/replay walk and quality of learned routing

use_case_families.current_behavior: Correction memory, replay and learning digest are declared capabilities; the catalogue separates stored correction from a fired correction.
gaps: The desktop application model does not yet state journal identity, replay status and correction outcome as one task view.

use_case_families.job: Say a phrase and run one configured Desk action

unknown: Physical speech recognition and command delivery to every target

use_case_families.current_behavior: The verb registry is the shared target source; the Commands manifest row is parked behind the Speak settings wing.
gaps: Voice proposals, menu commands and context commands need the same scoped target/availability outcome in each application.

use_case_families.job: Record a live meeting and stop cleanly

unknown: Hardware acceptance, CoreAudio conditions and owner-quality native recording glyph

use_case_families.current_behavior: Live meeting has a dedicated host; capture slices describe child process ownership, bounded Stop and callback recovery.
gaps: Recording session identity, focus ownership, interruption recovery and hardware feedback need one live-work application contract.

use_case_families.job: Import a recording or transcript as a normal Meeting

unknown: Unsupported format versus failed intelligence in a fresh owner run

use_case_families.current_behavior: Meeting import is a named capability and recipe C3; the history host is the declared meeting home.
gaps: Import source identity, file-drop semantics and operation outcomes are not a general desktop transfer contract.

use_case_families.job: Run meeting intelligence and read a useful result

unknown: Model result quality and full queued/running/failed/finished owner task

use_case_families.current_behavior: Saved meetings can be handed to an intelligence chain with retained analysis and result publication in the declared model.
gaps: Long-running work, retained background operation and mounted window state are not one shared application contract.

use_case_families.job: Review meeting outcomes and follow through on actions

unknown: Complete owner review/accept/reject cycle and source-linked follow-through on a fresh desk

use_case_families.current_behavior: Aftercare, decisions and actions have declared services and Today/Needs views; tracker C5/C6 and D3 cover recipe intent.
gaps: Cross-window source identity and pending/confirmed action outcomes need explicit application context.

use_case_families.job: Find the same meeting and result again after restart

unknown: A cold restart findability walk and long-list navigation

use_case_families.current_behavior: Meetings have an archive window and persisted backend identity in the declared model.
gaps: Large collection view state, stable selection and restoration are not established as one shared collection contract.

use_case_families.job: Ask a question about work on the Desk and get cited evidence

unknown: Model latency, refusal reason and owner acceptance of the current face

use_case_families.current_behavior: Ask is one manifest application with a composer, answer and source/context path; Q7/Q12 describe whole-desk Ask and Memory.
gaps: Request/session identity, interrupted work and source selection must remain coherent when Ask is opened from other windows.

use_case_families.job: Continue a saved specialist conversation with turns and tools

unknown: Production tool elicitation and full saved-thread recovery; parked test paths are not active proof

use_case_families.current_behavior: Thread is redirected to Ask through ThreadToAsk; persistent thread/tool capabilities are catalogued.
gaps: Conversation, tool result, draft and source panes need stable per-window identity and recovery.

use_case_families.job: Keep a useful answer as an Artifact with its source

unknown: Full answer-to-artifact owner walk and durable source citation validation

use_case_families.current_behavior: ArtifactPullout renders stored artifact/source relationships; Ask can retain a result through the object model.
gaps: Source identity and egress/egress-free result provenance should be explicit across answer and artifact windows.

use_case_families.job: Choose a project, object or source context before an operation

unknown: Cross-window context handoff and context removal after refresh

use_case_families.current_behavior: About/context chips and object-origin Ask are declared in Q5/Q6; selected object and front-window refs are separate seams.
gaps: Selection scope is global in some paths; application/view context must not be copied blindly into every window.

use_case_families.job: Write, edit and develop a note without losing text

unknown: IME, voice insertion and undo semantics across every editor consumer

use_case_families.current_behavior: Note and thought editors have durable draft/write seams and separate object pullout identity.
gaps: The source audit identifies append behavior instead of one shared selection/caret insertion primitive.

use_case_families.job: Keep reference material in a named drawer and use it as context

unknown: Large drawer selection and cross-window drag/attach behavior

use_case_families.current_behavior: Knowledge has a pullout/editor and named drawers have a DrawerWindow host; Q10 records the new drawer direction.
gaps: Drawer collection selection remains singular in active consumers; shared range/context semantics are missing.

use_case_families.job: Prepare for a 1:1 with one report

unknown: Provider relationship endpoint health and a populated owner desk

use_case_families.current_behavior: People has a manifest surface, roster and relationship pullout; prep capabilities are named.
gaps: Person identity, agenda, commitments and meeting launch need stable cross-window resource identity.

use_case_families.job: See where a project stands, what changed and what needs me

unknown: Owner visual acceptance and phone Room review workflow

use_case_families.current_behavior: Projects and project Room have separate declared list/memory and detailed consumers with sources, decisions and actions.
gaps: Room must participate in shared window/view identity, selection, navigation and operation outcomes rather than acting as a page-only template.

use_case_families.job: Create a project from a name and selected sources

unknown: Owner cold creation with real external source accounts

use_case_families.current_behavior: One-screen New Project door selects found sources and opens project memory by project identity.
gaps: Source provider status, partial selection and operation refusal need shared task outcomes and egress facts.

use_case_families.job: Draft a true project update without freezing the Desk

unknown: Inventory records the earlier 91-second/no-output failure and does not establish a later complete owner result

use_case_families.current_behavior: Project update is declared as a source-grounded draft and can be related to Automations/Send.
gaps: Retained background operation, draft identity, model refusal and visible outcome need a single task view.

use_case_families.job: Record, review and supersede an architecture decision

unknown: Owner acceptance of New Decision face and full same-ID decision loop

use_case_families.current_behavior: Decisions have list, pullout, lifecycle and meeting links; P9 records canonical same-ID links.
gaps: Decision identity, source provenance, edit conflict and supersede outcome need consistent application context.

use_case_families.job: See agent sessions, state and work that needs an answer

unknown: Real agent session availability, screen proof and owner acceptance

use_case_families.current_behavior: Agents is the canonical manifest host; Conductor lists state, questions and completed work.
gaps: Session identity, terminal/run monitor, focus and answer delivery must share application lifecycle and operation outcomes.

use_case_families.job: Hand selected work to an agent and steer it with permission

unknown: The HandSheet instruction delivery seam and OS file transfer; source notes that old global file-drop is parked

use_case_families.current_behavior: Internal Hand uses semantic object refs and agent hand sheets; object verbs derive from shared registry.
gaps: Explicit source/target transfer intent, refusal, interruption and recovery are not a general desktop file-transfer contract.

use_case_families.job: Read an agent result, review it and answer or approve

unknown: Real agent output quality, review authority and native terminal acceptance

use_case_families.current_behavior: Result, reviewer and answer recipes are declared; lane/terminal windows have specialized hosts.
gaps: Run identity, bounded scrollback, input ownership and durable review outcome need one monitor contract.

use_case_families.job: Create one automation with instruction, sources and one result

unknown: Actual scheduled run and failed-result recovery on owner data

use_case_families.current_behavior: Automations has a manifest surface and recipe slices A1-A7 for naming, instruction, sources, run and outcomes.
gaps: Application identity, run retention, stale state and failure reason need a complete task view.

use_case_families.job: Schedule or trigger repeat work and recover its result

unknown: Schedule firing, EventKit/calendar readiness and native notification quality

use_case_families.current_behavior: Workbenches is active; Rhythm is parked to Settings and retained as an alias/window id.
gaps: Retained operation versus mounted window and user-visible failure/receipt are not one shared lifecycle.

use_case_families.job: Run, inspect and retain a Desk tool operation

unknown: Every tool's UI caller, egress destination and owner task completion

use_case_families.current_behavior: MCP has backend families and seven tracker slices; some tool families have no direct face.
gaps: Tool operation identity, target context, egress and receipt need a consistent application-level inspector.

use_case_families.job: Prepare exact content and destination before sending

unknown: External destination account readiness and actual send authorization

use_case_families.current_behavior: SendWell is shared by several hosts; S3-S8 describe frozen preview, destination and unchecked warning behavior.
gaps: Prepare, edit, send and result-unknown states need one visible operation contract across hosts.

use_case_families.job: Send a stored document and retain the receipt

unknown: Tracker S2 is Open; no owner send proof is asserted here

use_case_families.current_behavior: The send cluster records S2 open and S3-S8 merged; channel capabilities name document and Slack sends.
gaps: First real send, external outcome and uncertain/retry state remain explicit open work.

use_case_families.job: Choose what runs where and verify engine readiness

unknown: Provider readiness, model quality and live engine execution

use_case_families.current_behavior: Engines has a dedicated surface; model registry/assignment/route capabilities are catalogued separately from physical execution.
gaps: Assignment, destination, execution and cancellation need explicit task identity and visible egress/outcome state.

use_case_families.job: Connect an account, check it and keep its boundary clear

unknown: Provider sign-in, remote account health and external side effects

use_case_families.current_behavior: Accounts is a parked manifest alias into Settings; settings rows expose provider/configuration seams.
gaps: Account identity, permission/egress state and conflict/recovery need an application-level settings contract.

use_case_families.job: Edit preferences and keep unsaved work visible

unknown: All settings sections on a cold owner desk and conflict handling

use_case_families.current_behavior: Settings is one manifest window with aliases for wallpaper, rhythm and integrations; preferences capability is documented.
gaps: A settings form alone does not prove the full application model; focus, command context and conflict outcomes need shared rules.

use_case_families.job: Check device readiness and use what was found

unknown: Physical device checks and owner adoption of found services

use_case_families.current_behavior: Setup is an active readiness surface; ST3-ST9 describe found things, use, accounts and agent bindings.
gaps: Readiness checks, adoption, permissions and operation outcomes need one application state model.

use_case_families.job: Show bounded native presence without stealing focus

unknown: Renderer root cause, fresh close/focus shot and repaired owner acceptance

use_case_families.current_behavior: Presence route and optional native host seams exist; current owner operation keeps it disabled after broken rendering.
gaps: No re-enable decision or native-quality proof; do not treat source host code as a working native application.

use_case_families.job: Open the Desk and find the work surface

unknown: Owner first-use walk and Tuesday findability across a fresh desk

use_case_families.current_behavior: Desk is the shared workspace route and application manifest projects into Go, Dock, menu and windows.
gaps: Native application identity is broader than a page shell; complete task views and resource contracts remain to be adopted.

use_case_families.job: Open, focus, arrange, minimize, restore and close windows

unknown: Full pointer/keyboard/touch restoration across all specialized hosts

use_case_families.current_behavior: Compositor, registry and workspace persistence own window geometry/front authority; window recipes are merged.
gaps: Mounted view, retained background operation and dirty document are not yet one explicit lifecycle across apps.

use_case_families.job: Navigate by Go, menu, Dock, palette and shared commands

unknown: All aliases, phone paths and target outcomes on owner hardware

use_case_families.current_behavior: Manifest and one verb registry feed navigation projections; parked rows route to Settings aliases.
gaps: Target scope, context and availability must remain identical across menu, key, voice and object commands.

use_case_families.job: Browse a registered repository in multiple windows and open a supported file

unknown: Two-window history, range selection, rename, transfer, stale reads, file open and large-folder behavior; no dedicated RepoWindow test path was found

use_case_families.current_behavior: RepoWindow reads registered-root tree/status/branches; file clicks select paths, folder clicks change local path and breadcrumbs exist.
gaps: No Back/Forward stack, document-opening view, shared Shift/range selection, durable resource identity or complete transfer contract. This is a proposed acceptance workload, not shipped explorer behavior.

use_case_families.job: Open an object, inspect it and run an available object verb

unknown: Every fallback kind's actual open destination and operation behavior

use_case_families.current_behavior: The pullout registry is exhaustive; specialized hosts exist for some kinds and FallbackPullout/redirect handles others.
gaps: Object identity, front-window context and selected-set command targeting are not yet one application contract.

use_case_families.job: Create, browse and use a named collection drawer

unknown: Current active drawer selection and large collection behavior; retired ZoneWindow is not active proof

use_case_families.current_behavior: New Drawer and DirectoryPullout are declared; old ZoneWindow is parked/excluded from active proof.
gaps: Per-view selection, range semantics and collection navigation need shared behavior; no filesystem claim follows from a Desk drawer.

use_case_families.job: Inspect a running process or terminal and stop it safely

unknown: Real process stop/recovery, terminal input ownership and bounded scrollback under load

use_case_families.current_behavior: Processes and agent lane/terminal hosts exist; terminal/readback surfaces are specialized.
gaps: Run identity, input ownership, copy/selection, follow/pause and real stop outcome need one run-monitor contract.

use_case_families.job: Inspect current-device activity and the always-on context

unknown: Fresh device activity availability and context refresh behavior

use_case_families.current_behavior: Activity and Context are distinct manifest tool windows; context is a builder/owner view.
gaps: Context/resource identity and refresh outcomes are not yet described as shared application task contracts.

use_case_families.job: Search memory and inspect a sourced result

unknown: Meaning-search quality, source owner labels and full memory findability

use_case_families.current_behavior: Memory has a manifest window and generated knowledge/memory capabilities; Q11/Q12 describe search and sourced answers.
gaps: Memory result identity, source display and restoration need a durable collection/detail contract.

use_case_families.job: Edit text with keyboard, IME, voice and undo semantics intact

unknown: Cross-consumer IME, voice insertion and undo walk

use_case_families.current_behavior: Native inputs, mic gadgets, CodeMirror selection and global IME guards exist in separate seams.
gaps: A shared caret/selection insertion adapter is explicitly identified as missing; do not replace native editing with a parallel framework.

use_case_families.job: Know immediately what an operation did, refused or cannot yet prove

unknown: Consistent visible feedback across all active apps and external egress outcomes

use_case_families.current_behavior: Verb ghosting and runtime feedback seams exist; capability records distinguish evidence and egress.
gaps: Pending, refusal, partial and indeterminate outcomes are not yet one shared application operation surface.

use_case_families.job: Review calendar evidence and schedule a meeting recording

unknown: EventKit, sign-in, populated snapshot and schedule firing

use_case_families.current_behavior: Calendar snapshot and schedule creation have dedicated hosts and services; schedule is a capture/setup concern.
gaps: Calendar event identity, schedule lifecycle and recording outcome need shared persistence and operation feedback.

use_case_families.job: Demonstrate the same application behavior with isolated fixture data

unknown: Reference behavior is not proof of production consumer adoption or owner delight

use_case_families.current_behavior: Components is a declared reference surface and the application model asks it to consume the same app/view models with fixture adapters.
gaps: Reference-to-production adoption and explorer task proof are not established.

use_case_families.job: See what needs attention today and keep commitments moving

unknown: Fresh owner desk population, ambient notification reach and complete follow-through walk

use_case_families.current_behavior: Today, Needs you and follow-through are active declared hosts; D1-D10 consolidate counts, rows and notices.
gaps: Multiple entry surfaces still answer the same attention question; one shared task/resource identity and operation outcome is not established.

critical_gaps.title: Explorer application contract is proposed, not shipped
Selection is not shared across Screen, drawers and collection views
Per-window navigation history and restoration are missing in RepoWindow
Transfer semantics are split between internal Hand, browser files and OS file-manager integration
One caret/selection insertion contract is not shared by mic consumers
Native presence is disabled after a broken renderer; repair and owner proof are unknown
Mounted window, retained operation and dirty document lifecycle is not explicit across apps
Terminal/run-monitor input, scroll, stop and recovery are not one contract
Capability and tracker completion do not establish owner observation or native acceptance
External provider readiness, egress and operation outcomes remain unknown for accounts, engines and sends
Physical speech, recording hardware, WebKit and assistive-technology task proof are not established
Send S2 remains open and project update result is not established by the current records

audit_result.tuesday_question: The Desk has many declared windows and jobs, but the owner cannot yet be assumed to complete the explorer/resource workload on a Tuesday; the critical gaps above are the bounded reasons.
